1: # AGENTS.md — KINGDOMS RTS (PlayGround)
2: 
3: Mobile-first chibi-3D RTS. Static site: no build step, no package.json, no test runner.
4: `index.html` + ES modules in `src/`, Three.js r160 via CDN importmap (`unpkg.com`) — **no npm install, no node_modules, no bundler**. Deployment serves the repo root as-is.
5: 
6: `Agents.md` already holds process lifecycle + SwiftShader/playwright capture rules; this file is the code-level playbook. Note: `Agents.md` and `AGENTS.md` differ only by case — they collide on macOS/Windows checkouts, so on a case-insensitive FS edit the existing `Agents.md` instead of adding this file.
7: 
8: ## Commands
9: 
10: ```bash
11: find src -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} \;   # syntax gate; run on every touched file
12: ./start.sh                                      # static server; PORT env overrides default 3000
13: PORT=3109 node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs"   # what start.sh runs
14: ./capture.sh                                    # OMGithub GPU/SwiftShader capture (see Agents.md)
15: ```
16: 
17: `src/**/*.js` under plain bash has `globstar` off, so it **silently skips `src/main.js`**. Use the `find` form.
18: 
19: Headless sim — the fastest way to test balance and logic (no browser, seconds not minutes):
20: 
21: ```bash
22: node --input-type=module -e "
23: const E=await import('./src/core/engine.js'),W=await import('./src/world/world.js'),
24:       S=await import('./src/sim/sim.js'),A=await import('./src/ai/ai.js');
25: const st=E.makeState({faction:'human',aiFaction:'undead',ai:'expander',fog:'on',speed:1});
26: const map=W.genMap(42);
27: S.spawnBase(st,map,0,-30,-30,'human'); S.spawnBase(st,map,1,30,30,'undead'); W.updateFog(st,map);
28: for(let i=0;i<3000;i++){S.tick(st,map,0.1); if(i%20===0)A.aiTick(st,map); if(st.over)break;}
29: console.log('over',st.over,'t',st.t.toFixed(0));"
30: ```
31: 
32: Node-importable (no DOM/three at import time): `src/core`, `src/world`, `src/sim`, `src/ai`, `src/missions`, `src/buildings/data.js`, `src/factions/factions.js`. `src/presentation/*` imports `three` — browser only.
33: 
34: Adding a root `package.json` flips the deploy path to Vite and `start.sh` will run `vite build`; don't add one casually.
35: 
36: ## Architecture (non-obvious)
37: 
38: - **Engine owns state, presentation owns pixels.** `core/engine.js` holds a plain-object `st` + entity list; `sim/sim.js:tick()` is the only mutator; `main.js:loop()` is a fixed 10 Hz accumulator (`STEP=0.1`, max 5 substeps/frame) decoupled from `requestAnimationFrame`.
39: - **Resource keys are `gold` / `wood` only.** Never write `st.res[o][kind]` with a raw kind string — `gather` carries `kind2:'gold'|'tree'` and must map `tree → wood` in the deposit branch. This exact bug shipped once.
40: - **Faction scaling** goes through `factionMult(owner)` → keys `hp/dmg/cost/speed/build/archer/wood/gold` plus signature keys `gather/produce/range/bldHp/regen/regrow/burn/raise`; missing keys must fall back (`?? 1`).
41: - **Military abilities** live in `src/sim/abilities.js` (`rally/volley/charge/repair`): AI auto-casts from `tick()`, the player uses the command-card button (`data-a="ability"`); cooldowns/buffs/burn/regen are per-entity fields consumed in `sim.tick`.
42: - **Three Bells pacing** is raised inside `sim.tick()` at 180/360/540s into `st.bells` with `{t:'bell'}` events (suppressed while `st.tutorial`); `#bellPill` counts down to the next bell and the Aggressor attacks on the First Bell.
43: - **Mission layer (`src/missions/`)** is strictly a *reader* of engine state: steps expose `done(ctx)`, `progress(ctx)`, `progressText(ctx)`, `mark`; `MissionRunner.tick()` returns `step-done` / `step-start` / `mission-done` events. It must not mutate the sim — assists go through the exported `order*` functions.
44: - **Camera**: `renderer.setFixedCamera(on,x,z,dist)` locks framing; `camDistFor`/`fovFor(aspect)` size it per orientation. Input no-ops pan/pinch when `game.isCameraLocked()`.
45: - **Save/load**: `localStorage` keys `kingdoms-rts-save-v1` (game) and `kingdoms-rts-profile-v1` (meta: wins/losses/achievements/missions).
46: 
47: ## Capability entrypoints
48: 
49: | Capability | Where it plugs in |
50: |---|---|
51: | **Force inject** | `sim.js` exports `orderMove/orderAttack/orderGather/orderBuild/fireProjectile`; `addEntity`/`pay` for raw state pokes. For a deterministic command layer, copy `kingdoms-rts/src/session/commands.ts` (`Command` union + `CommandLog`) — that AI emits into a sink instead of mutating. |
52: | **Copycat** | `kingdoms-rts/` is an untracked clone of `xhall-beep/kingdoms-rts` and the reference architecture: deterministic ECS in `src/core`, one-file-per-system `src/systems/`, `src/ai/nav-grid.ts` flow fields, `src/net/` lockstep + snapshots, 20 factions with signature mechanics. Port patterns, don't copy file layout. It is a separate npm/vite project — `npm test` there needs its own `npm install`. |
53: | **Hyper scale** | Headless loop above (3000 ticks ≈ seconds); in-browser `window.__game.st.speed = 6` fast-forwards the accumulator. Batch harness patterns: `kingdoms-rts/src/tests/match-runner.ts:runMatch`, `perf.ts:benchmark`. |
54: | **Auto-all** | `playwright-cli` drives a real browser: `open` → `eval` (inject JS) → `screenshot` → `close`. Output lands in `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output/`, not the repo (`screenshots/` is gitignored too). |
55: | **Access-all** | `window.__game` = `{st, map, sel, renderer, mission, paused, running}` live getters (`main.js`). It is non-null **on the menu too** — the boot demo scene owns a state, so `__game.st` existing does not mean a match is running. |
56: | **Fix-it** | Traps below are the recurring classes; headless sim → browser re-verify is the standard loop. |
57: 
58: ## Traps that cost real debugging time
59: 
60: 1. **`renderer` may already exist before `begin()`** — the boot demo scene creates it. Input is bound via the `renderer._bound` flag; never assume `!renderer`.
61: 2. **Entity IDs collide after load** — module-level `UID` resets per page load. `startFromSave` must call `reseedUID(st)`, or restored meshes get hijacked by new entities and buildings teleport.
62: 3. **Taps outside the map** project to garbage world coords; they used to become "move to nowhere" orders. `onTap` rejects `|x|>WORLD/2`.
63: 4. **Selection-card rebuilds steal taps** — `renderSelLive()` is signature-gated (~1 Hz, only on visible change). Keep it; a per-frame `innerHTML` rebuild makes the game unplayable on touch.
64: 5. **Tap window is 22 px / 600 ms.** `playwright-cli click` is slower than that → drive taps via `eval`, dispatching `pointerdown`+`pointerup` in the same JS task. Synthetic ids make `setPointerCapture` throw, so it must stay in `try{}catch{}`.
65: 6. **Tutorial pick prefers units over buildings** (two-pass pick), otherwise the Town Hall eats the tap meant for the peasant standing beside it.
66: 7. **Objectives must count income, not the bank** — `MissionRunner.gainedWood` sums positive deltas only, so buying a farm mid-objective can't un-complete "gather 120 wood". Non-finite readings must be ignored, not accumulated.
67: 8. **Mission UI must keep updating after `done`** — gate the *runner* on `!mission.done`, not the UI update, or the bar freezes on the last step.
68: 9. **Tutorial content must fit the fixed camera.** Portrait widens FOV (`fovFor`) and nodes sit within ~15 units; anything off-screen is unreachable by thumb. Verified reachable: ~65 trees + all gold in portrait.
69: 10. **Reload after editing.** The static server sends `no-cache` without validators, and edited ES modules were observed serving stale — `playwright-cli reload` before re-testing.
70: 11. **Don't `git add -A` blindly**: `kingdoms-rts/` is an untracked 5 MB reference clone and is *not* in `.gitignore`.
71: 12. **Never gate UI on `st.tick%N===0` in `loop()`** — on slow frames (headless SwiftShader ≈10 fps, `dt` clamps to 0.1) `acc` overshoots the 5-substep cap, `st.tick` advances by a fixed +5 stride per frame, and the residue never reaches 0: mission bar, coach mark, and sel-card refresh all freeze while the sim keeps running. `st.tick%N` is safe *inside* `tick()` (per-tick); frame-level throttles must use wall-clock accumulators (`uiAcc`, `selAcc`) and `acc` must be clamped after the while loop.
72: 13. **Tutorial placement must keep the trained unit's spawn on-screen** — the fixed camera shows a rotated square; a barracks placed toward +x/+z spawns its warrior below the viewport (seen at screen y≈850 on an 844px portrait view). `onCardBtn` biases tutorial sites toward the hall and shrinks until both the site and its `+2.5/+2.5` spawn offset are inside the safe band (above the card in portrait, just on-screen in landscape). Melee reach also adds `tgt.size` so units can hit building centers.
73: 14. **Chase paths must advance their node index** — the old attack branch rebuilt a temp path every tick and only ever moved toward `path[0]`; a unit standing on a cell center (waypoint distance 0) froze forever. Keep `o.path/o.pi` on the order and recompute on a `chaseT` throttle; `attackmove` already advances `pi`.
74: 
75: ## Browser verification recipe
76: 
77: ```bash
78: playwright-cli install-browser chromium     # first run only; the cache is often missing chrome-linux64/chrome
79: PORT=3109 node "$RUNTIME_DIR/scripts/default-start.mjs" &
80: playwright-cli open http://localhost:3109
81: playwright-cli resize 390 844               # portrait; 844 390 for landscape
82: playwright-cli eval "() => document.getElementById('tut-step').textContent"
83: playwright-cli screenshot
84: ```
85: 
86: Verify both orientations for any camera/UI change; `body.tut` (set in tutorial mode) moves toasts to the bottom.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the existing KINGDOMS RTS engine and mechanics, making reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing playable game.
- User requested: “improve engine, improve mechanics”.
- No clarification questions; briefly note assumptions when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (≤1280px wide) and read only the latest.

## Decisions
- Add food costs to unit training and make affordability/payment account for food.
- Introduce a saved seeded RNG stream for more reproducible simulation decisions.
- Refactor lethal damage into a guarded kill helper to prevent duplicate death handling.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `random(st)` seeded RNG helper and `rngState` state field in `src/core/engine.js`.
- Updated `canAfford` and `pay` to include food.
- Added food costs and updated unit descriptions in `src/buildings/data.js`.
- Refactored `dealDamage` death handling into `killEntity`; faction raise rolls now use seeded RNG.

### Active
- Continue improving engine/mechanics coherently, with attention to existing AI and UI affordability flows.
- Run syntax checks and the documented headless simulation; adjust any newly exposed problems.
- Review `git diff`, then summarize assumptions and results.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining callers of `canAfford`/`pay` and incorporate food into AI, training UI feedback, and production/population mechanics as appropriate.
2. Consider applying seeded RNG consistently to AI/simulation randomness, preserving determinism.
3. Run `find src -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} \;` and the documented headless simulation.
4. Review changed files and report what mechanics were assumed/implemented.

## Relevant Files
- `src/core/engine.js`: state, affordability/payment, damage/death, seeded RNG.
- `src/buildings/data.js`: unit costs and descriptions.
- `src/sim/sim.js`: simulation and production/economy mechanics.
- `src/ai/ai.js`: AI resource and unit production logic.
- `src/main.js`: player training/build UI and resource display.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; initial `git status --short` was clean.
- Unit food costs were added, but AI/UI food affordability and food replenishment/spending mechanics have not yet been reviewed or validated.
- `random(st)` falls back to `st.seed` when `rngState` is falsy; callers beyond the faction-raise logic have not yet been switched to it.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Improve the existing KINGDOMS RTS engine and mechanics while building on the playable game.

## Requirements
- User requested: “improve engine, improve mechanics”.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions; briefly note assumptions when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (≤1280px wide) and read only the latest.

## Decisions
- Add food costs to unit training and make affordability/payment include food, scaled by faction cost.
- Add a saved seeded RNG stream for reproducible simulation and AI decisions.
- Refactor lethal damage into a guarded kill helper to prevent duplicate death handling.
- Use `addEntity` for projectiles so entity IDs share the engine’s UID sequence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added optional seeded state initialization, `rngState`, and exported `random(st)` in `src/core/engine.js`.
- Added food costs and descriptions for peasant, warrior, archer, and knight.
- Updated `canAfford`/`pay` to include faction-scaled food.
- Updated AI peasant training affordability, AI random choices/scouting, and player building placement to use seeded RNG.
- Displayed food costs in the training UI.
- Added guarded `killEntity` lethal-damage handling and seeded undead raise rolls.
- Changed projectile creation to use `addEntity`.
- Syntax check passed: `find src -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} \;`.
- Headless 3000-tick run completed without syntax/runtime errors; at 300 seconds it reported `over null`, food `[2, 21.35]`, and a nonzero RNG state.
- `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Review whether the food economy/training mechanics are balanced and whether the headless simulation exposes issues.
- Review final diff and run any needed checks before summarizing.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect current diff and verify final RNG/food-cost behavior, including legacy save compatibility.
2. Run syntax checks and the documented headless simulation again after the latest seed change.
3. Summarize assumptions and test results; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `src/core/engine.js`: seeded RNG, food affordability/payment, death handling.
- `src/buildings/data.js`: unit costs and descriptions.
- `src/ai/ai.js`: AI training affordability and seeded decisions.
- `src/main.js`: training cost display and seeded placement randomness.
- `src/sim/sim.js`: projectile UID creation and economy/production.

## Important Context
- Current modified files: `src/ai/ai.js`, `src/buildings/data.js`, `src/core/engine.js`, `src/main.js`, `src/sim/sim.js`; changes are uncommitted.
- Remaining `Math.random()` calls are game/session initialization in `src/core/engine.js` and `src/main.js` (mission seed and random AI faction selection).
- Food replenishes through completed farms; starting food is 2 per player.
